acceptance.criterion: dedupe(seq) returns the distinct items in order of first appearance
acceptance.check: python3 -c "from dd import dedupe; assert dedupe([3,1,3,2,1])==[3,1,2]"

acceptance.criterion: dedupe does not modify its argument
acceptance.check: python3 -c "from dd import dedupe; s=[2,2,1]; dedupe(s); assert s==[2,2,1]"

checks.command: python3 -c "from dd import dedupe; assert dedupe([3,1,3,2,1])==[3,1,2]"
python3 -c "from dd import dedupe; s=[2,2,1]; dedupe(s); assert s==[2,2,1]"

@@ -1,2 +1,7 @@
 def dedupe(seq):
-    raise NotImplementedError
